name: mirage
text: Yes: Novig and SharpAPI are both fixed (SharpAPI 9,514 NFL lines from 16 books instead of 118 from 1; Novig stream holding ~3,400 markets with the key's own allowance, cold scans 190 s instead of ~10 min). SX Bet: the engine's status line counts only games SX flags as in play and the live-state count is separate, so I can't yet say if it's a matching problem. I'm adding a breakdown of what SX's socket hears (scores, fixture statuses, games matched into Vigilant's leagues) to the next engine run and will tell you what it shows.
